levels.surface: جعفر بن سعد بن سمرة بن جندب

notes: «عن أبيه، سليمان بن سمرة» : «أبيه» with the name that follows is one link, written as the name alone (rule 7)
«سليمان بن موسى أبو داود» is a shaykh whose kunya matches the compiler's; the surface is written as the text gives it, and the compiler is not written as a link
